transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve just been feeling really low for a long time. Like a couple years. Even when I’m at work or at church or around people I care about, it’s still there—this heavy, empty feeling that doesn’t really go away.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I still do some things, but I don’t know if I’d call it enjoying them like before.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to like?
I… I don’t know. Maybe a little. I still do some things, but it’s hard to tell if I actually like them anymore or if I’m just going through the motions.
Have you had times where you felt better, and then the low feeling came back?

Not really… I mean, maybe there are moments where I’m distracted, but the low feeling is kind of always there. It’s been that way for a couple years. Even at work or church, or around people, it doesn’t really lift.
Have you ever had a period where you felt completely back to normal?
No… I don’t think so. Maybe I have moments where I’m distracted, but I don’t really feel back to normal. It’s just kind of always there.
Have you had periods where the low feeling gets even worse, and then gets a little better before coming back?
Yeah… I guess it can feel heavier sometimes. But mostly it’s just been there all the time for the last couple years. Even if I’m at work or church or with people I care about, it doesn’t really lift.
Do you think of your low feelings as coming and going in episodes, or is it more of a steady state?

It feels more steady… not really like episodes. For the last couple years it’s just kind of been there, this low, empty feeling. Even when I’m at work or at church or with people, it doesn’t really lift.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight over the past couple of years?

Yeah… some. It kind of goes up and down. A lot of days I don’t eat much until my shift’s almost over, or I just grab junk from the vending machine later. My work pants fit different some months, so… I’ve noticed it.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I tend to think I should be handling things better, but I don’t really want to get into all of that.
Have you ever had a time when you didn't feel this low, and then it started again?
Not really. It’s been pretty constant… I guess about two years and a few months now. It started around when I had to stop taking community college classes, because of money and my work schedule.
Does your low feeling seem to change at different times of the year?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed it being tied to winter or summer or anything… it just kind of stays there.
Have you ever had more than two weeks where you felt completely normal and the low feeling was gone?
No… I don’t think I’ve had a stretch like that. It’s been there pretty much the whole time, since I had to stop community college… about two years and four months ago.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months where you didn't feel this low?
No… I don’t think so. It’s been pretty much there since I stopped community college classes—about two years and four months now.
Have you ever had a major depressive episode where your low mood was even worse than it typically is?
I mean… it’s been low pretty much all the time. I’m not sure I’d call it a separate episode. It’s just this heavy, empty feeling that’s there even when I’m at work or around people.
Does the intensity of your low feeling change from day to day?
A little, I guess… some days feel heavier than others. But it doesn’t really go away. Even at work or church, or around people I care about, it’s still kind of there… that empty, low feeling.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
I don’t know… not especially, I guess. I worry about stuff sometimes, but I haven’t really thought of it as a main thing.
Has there ever been a time when this low feeling completely went away for any amount of time?

Not really. I mean… maybe it gets a little less noticeable sometimes, but for the last couple years it’s felt like it’s always there. Even at work or church or with people I care about, it doesn’t really lift.
Does your low feeling seem to change around the time of your menstrual period?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed it being tied to that… it just kind of feels the same most of the time.
Has your low feeling ever completely gone away and then come back?
No… I don’t think it’s ever fully gone away. It’s more like it’s been there for the last couple years, just this low, heavy feeling, even when I’m doing normal stuff.
Can you think of anything that happened around the time this low feeling started, about two years and four months ago?
Yeah… I guess around then I had to stop taking my community college classes. It was money, and my work schedule got in the way. That was about two years and a few months ago.
